J-09.name: Stop watching a ticker
J-09.notes: PROMOTED failing -> PASSING in iter-7 (full depth) — the NINTH and final Must-have journey; the MVP watch lifecycle (start -> read -> stop -> re-start) is now complete. Verified skeptically by primary evidence I gathered directly, not summary-trust. BACKEND CODE (read directly): WatchManager.stop() (watch_manager.py:60) returns False if not watched (idempotent, raises nothing), cancels+pops the feeder, calls the PRE-EXISTING engine.set_stream_status('closed') setter (one producer), and del self._engines[ticker] (engine removal = fresh cold re-watch). DELETE /watch/{ticker} (main.py:75) raises HTTPException(404) on not-watched (HONEST 404, never a fabricated success) and returns {'status':'stopped'} on success.
